name: SendPulse
description: Let your AI work with SendPulse: mailing lists and contacts, e-mail campaigns and their statistics, single transactional e-mails through the SMTP service with their delivery log, and the chats of your WhatsApp and Telegram chatbots. Client ID and secret.
instructions:
## SendPulse
This connector works with the **SendPulse REST API** (`https://api.sendpulse.com`) of one SendPulse account: mailing lists and their contacts, e-mail campaigns and their statistics, templates, senders, the blacklist and the balance; the **SMTP service** for single transactional e-mails and their delivery log; SMS (switched off); and the **WhatsApp and Telegram chatbots** with their chats and messages.

**Setup (about 2 minutes)**
1. Sign in at https://login.sendpulse.com and open **Settings**, tab **API**, section **Client credentials**.
2. Copy the **ID** into `SENDPULSE_CLIENT_ID` and the **Secret** into `SENDPULSE_CLIENT_SECRET`.

The connector exchanges them at `/oauth/access_token` (client credentials) for a token that lasts one hour and renews it by itself.

**Where to start**: `sendpulse_get_balance_details` shows the plan and what is left of it. `sendpulse_list_mailing_lists` gives the list ids, `sendpulse_list_campaigns` the campaigns.

**Mailing lists and contacts**: `sendpulse_list_mailing_lists`, `sendpulse_get_mailing_list`, `sendpulse_list_mailing_list_variables`, `sendpulse_list_mailing_list_emails`,`sendpulse_create_mailing_list`, `sendpulse_add_emails_to_mailing_list`, `sendpulse_unsubscribe_emails` and `sendpulse_remove_emails_from_mailing_list` (switched off at install). `sendpulse_get_email_info` and `sendpulse_get_email_campaign_stats` look one address up across the account.

**Campaigns**: `sendpulse_list_campaigns` and `sendpulse_get_campaign` (with the statistics) are reads. `sendpulse_create_campaign` mails a whole list and `sendpulse_cancel_campaign` stops a scheduled one; both are switched off at install. `sendpulse_list_templates`, `sendpulse_list_senders`, `sendpulse_list_blacklist`, `sendpulse_get_balance`.

**Transactional e-mail**: `sendpulse_send_smtp_email` sends one e-mail to one or a few people through the SMTP service, which must be activated in the account first (SMTP, Settings: SendPulse reviews a short application). `sendpulse_list_smtp_senders` shows the allowed From addresses. `sendpulse_list_smtp_emails` and `sendpulse_get_smtp_email` are the delivery log with opens and clicks; `sendpulse_list_smtp_bounces` and `sendpulse_list_smtp_unsubscribed` show who cannot be reached.

**SMS**: `sendpulse_send_sms` costs money per message and is switched off at install.

**Chatbots**: `sendpulse_list_whatsapp_bots`, `sendpulse_list_whatsapp_chats`, `sendpulse_list_whatsapp_messages`, `sendpulse_get_whatsapp_contact_by_phone` and `sendpulse_send_whatsapp_message`; `sendpulse_list_telegram_bots`, `sendpulse_list_telegram_chats`, `sendpulse_list_telegram_messages` and `sendpulse_send_telegram_message`. First list the bots for a `bot_id`, then the chats for a `contact_id`.

**Field notes**
- HTML must be Base64: the SMTP service and campaigns take the HTML of an e-mail Base64-encoded (UTF-8), while `text` is plain. The connector cannot encode it for you, so pass `html_base64` already encoded and keep the HTML short, or use a stored template with variables, which needs no encoding.
- Contact statuses in a list: New, Active, Unsubscribed, Rejected (hard bounce), Blocked, awaiting confirmation. Campaigns only go to New and Active.
- Dates are `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` in the time zone of the account; chatbot timestamps are ISO 8601.
- Paging: `limit` and `offset` for the e-mail service, `size` and `skip` for chatbots. A contact list returns at most 100 rows per call.
- WhatsApp: a free-form message is only delivered within 24 hours after the contact last wrote; outside that window WhatsApp requires an approved template.
- Limits: at most 10 requests per second, and per-minute and per-day quotas that depend on the plan; SendPulse answers 429 when they are used up. A campaign can be created at most 4 times per hour.
- Chatbot answers are wrapped as `success` and `data`; the e-mail service answers plain lists and objects, with errors as `error_code` and `message`.
prerequisites: A SendPulse account (the free plan works) and its API client credentials from Settings, API. Sending transactional e-mails also needs the SMTP service activated in the account. About 2 minutes.

SENDPULSE_CLIENT_ID.label: Client ID
SENDPULSE_CLIENT_ID.help: SendPulse, Settings, tab API, Client credentials: the ID.
SENDPULSE_CLIENT_ID.patternMessage: Paste the ID only, letters and digits without spaces.

SENDPULSE_CLIENT_SECRET.label: Client secret
SENDPULSE_CLIENT_SECRET.help: SendPulse, Settings, tab API, Client credentials: the Secret.
SENDPULSE_CLIENT_SECRET.patternMessage: Paste the Secret only, letters and digits without spaces.

verifyHints.400: SendPulse refused the request; the message names the field. An HTML body that is not Base64, or a sender address that is not confirmed, are the usual causes.
verifyHints.401: SendPulse did not issue or accept a token for this ID and Secret. Copy both again from Settings, API, Client credentials.
verifyHints.403: The account may not use this service. The SMTP service and some chatbot functions must be activated or are part of a paid plan.
verifyHints.404: SendPulse found no mailing list, campaign, e-mail or contact with that id.
verifyHints.rate_limited: SendPulse allows at most 10 requests per second and has per-minute and per-day quotas that depend on the plan. Wait and try again.

tools.name: sendpulse_list_mailing_lists
tools.description: List the mailing lists (address books) of the account: id, name, all_email_qty, active_email_qty, inactive_email_qty, phone counts, creationdate and status_explain (Active, Blocked and so on). Start here to get list ids. Read-only; page with limit and offset.

offset.description: Number of records to skip, for paging.

tools.name: sendpulse_get_mailing_list
tools.description: Read one mailing list by id: name, the counts of all, active and inactive e-mail addresses, creation date and status. Read-only.

tools.name: sendpulse_list_mailing_list_variables
tools.description: List the variables (custom fields such as name or city) defined for a mailing list, each with name and type (string, number, date). Use the names when adding contacts with variables. Read-only.

tools.name: sendpulse_list_mailing_list_emails
tools.description: List the contacts of a mailing list: email, status and status_explain (New, Active, Unsubscribed, Rejected, Blocked and others), and the variables stored for each. Read-only, at most 100 per call; page with limit and offset.

limit.description: Number of records to return (at most 100).

offset.description: Number of records to skip, for paging.

active.description: true returns only contacts with the status Active or New.

not_active.description: true returns only inactive contacts (unsubscribed, rejected, unconfirmed).

tools.name: sendpulse_create_mailing_list
tools.description: Create a new, empty mailing list (address book) with the given name. Returns its id. Add contacts afterwards with sendpulse_add_emails_to_mailing_list.

name.description: Name of the new mailing list.

tools.name: sendpulse_add_emails_to_mailing_list
tools.description: Add contacts to a mailing list without a confirmation e-mail (single opt-in). Each entry is an e-mail address, or an object with email and variables. Returns result true. Only add people who agreed to receive mail from this sender; added addresses count towards the plan's subscriber quota.

emails.description: Contacts to add: plain addresses `["jane@example.com"]`, or objects with variables `[{"email":"jane@example.com","variables":{"name":"Jane","Phone":"+4915112345678"}}]`.

tools.name: sendpulse_unsubscribe_emails
tools.description: Unsubscribe contacts from one mailing list: they stay in the list with the status Unsubscribed and receive no more campaigns sent to it. Use it to honour an opt-out request. Returns result true.

emails.description: E-mail addresses to unsubscribe from this list.

tools.name: sendpulse_remove_emails_from_mailing_list
tools.description: Delete contacts from a mailing list, up to 100 addresses per call. Their variables and history in that list are lost; to stop mailings but keep the record use sendpulse_unsubscribe_emails. Installed switched off.

emails.description: E-mail addresses to delete from this list.

tools.name: sendpulse_get_email_info
tools.description: Look up one e-mail address across the whole account: every mailing list it is in (book_id), its status there (New, Active, Unsubscribed and so on) and the variables stored for it. Read-only.

email.description: E-mail address to look up, e.g. jane@example.com.

tools.name: sendpulse_get_email_campaign_stats
tools.description: Read what one e-mail address received: statistic with the number of campaigns sent, opened (open) and clicked (link), whether it is on the blacklist, and the mailing lists it belongs to. Read-only.

email.description: E-mail address to look up, e.g. jane@example.com.

tools.name: sendpulse_list_campaigns
tools.description: List the e-mail campaigns of the account: id, name, status (a code: 0 new, 1 in moderation, 2 sending, 3 sent, 16 cancelled by the user), send_date, all_email_qty, the price and the sender data. Read-only; page with limit and offset.

offset.description: Number of records to skip, for paging.

tools.name: sendpulse_get_campaign
tools.description: Read one e-mail campaign with its results: name, message (sender_name, sender_email, subject, body, list_id), status, send_date, all_email_qty, permalink and statistics (counts for Sent, Delivered, Opened, Link redirected, User unsubscribe, Marked as spam and the error groups). Read-only.

tools.name: sendpulse_create_campaign
tools.description: Create an e-mail campaign that is sent to every active contact of a mailing list, at once or at send_date. Uses a stored template (template_id) or an HTML body passed as Base64. Returns the campaign id. This mails a whole list and counts against the plan (at most 4 campaigns per hour). Installed switched off; once switched on, confirm sender, subject, list and time with the user.

sender_email.description: Sender address; must be a confirmed sender (sendpulse_list_senders), e.g. jane@example.com.

template_id.description: Id of a stored template (id or real_id from sendpulse_list_templates). Give this or body_base64.

body_base64.description: HTML of the e-mail, Base64-encoded (UTF-8). Give this or template_id.

send_date.description: When to send, as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS; not in the past. Leave out to send at once.

is_test.description: true sends only one test e-mail to the sender address.

tools.name: sendpulse_cancel_campaign
tools.description: Cancel a scheduled e-mail campaign that has not started sending yet. A campaign that is already being sent cannot be stopped this way. Returns result true. Installed switched off.

tools.name: sendpulse_list_templates
tools.description: List e-mail templates: id, real_id, name, name_slug, lang, category, created and preview. With owner me only the account's own templates, otherwise SendPulse's system templates. The id or real_id is what campaigns and transactional e-mails take as template id. Read-only.

owner.description: me returns only your own templates.

tools.name: sendpulse_list_senders
tools.description: List the sender addresses of the account for campaigns: email, name, status (Active or awaiting confirmation) and is_allowed_for_smtp. Only an active sender can be used as the From address. Read-only.

tools.name: sendpulse_list_blacklist
tools.description: List the e-mail addresses on the account's blacklist: addresses that never receive a campaign, whatever list they are in. The answer is a plain list of addresses. Read-only.

tools.name: sendpulse_get_balance
tools.description: Read the money balance of the account in its currency: currency and balance_currency. It pays for extras such as SMS and overage; the e-mail quota of the plan is shown by sendpulse_get_balance_details. Read-only.

tools.name: sendpulse_get_balance_details
tools.description: Read the detailed balance and plan of the account: balance (main, bonus, currency) and, per service (email, smtp, push), the tariff name, its limits, what is used and when it ends. Read-only.

tools.name: sendpulse_send_smtp_email
tools.description: Send one transactional e-mail through the SendPulse SMTP service to one or a few recipients (not a list). Returns result true and the message id. Give the content either as a stored template (template), or as text together with html_base64, the HTML Base64-encoded. The sender must be a confirmed SMTP sender (sendpulse_list_smtp_senders). The e-mail leaves at once, so confirm recipient, subject and text with the user.

from_email.description: Sender address; a confirmed SMTP sender, e.g. jane@example.com.

from_name.description: Sender name shown to the recipient.

text.description: Plain-text version of the e-mail. Needed unless a template is used.

html_base64.description: HTML version of the e-mail, Base64-encoded (UTF-8). Needed together with text unless a template is used; simple HTML such as paragraphs of the same text is enough.

template.description: A stored template instead of text and html_base64: an object with id (id or real_id from sendpulse_list_templates) and variables, e.g. `{"id":123456,"variables":{"name":"Jane","code":"123456"}}`.

cc.description: Recipients in copy, same shape as to.

bcc.description: Recipients in blind copy, same shape as to.

auto_plain_text.description: true lets SendPulse build the text part from the HTML.

tools.name: sendpulse_list_smtp_emails
tools.description: List the transactional e-mails sent through the SMTP service, newest first: id, sender, recipient, subject, send_date, smtp_answer_code and smtp_answer_data (the delivery answer) and tracking (opens and clicks). Read-only; page with limit and offset.

offset.description: Number of records to skip, for paging.

from.description: Only e-mails sent on or after this day, as YYYY-MM-DD.

to.description: Only e-mails sent on or before this day, as YYYY-MM-DD.

sender.description: Only e-mails from this sender address.

recipient.description: Only e-mails to this recipient address.

tools.name: sendpulse_get_smtp_email
tools.description: Read one transactional e-mail by its id: sender, recipient, subject, send_date, the SMTP answer of the receiving server (code and text) and tracking with every open and click (time, browser, country). Read-only.

id.description: Message id (from sendpulse_list_smtp_emails or the send answer), e.g. pzkic9-0afezp-fc.

tools.name: sendpulse_list_smtp_bounces
tools.description: List the transactional e-mails that bounced within 24 hours: the addresses and the SMTP answer that explains each bounce. Without date it covers the last 24 hours. Read-only; page with limit and offset.

date.description: Day to report on, as YYYY-MM-DD.

offset.description: Number of records to skip, for paging.

tools.name: sendpulse_list_smtp_unsubscribed
tools.description: List the recipients who unsubscribed from transactional e-mails or reported them as spam: email, unsubscribe_by_link, unsubscribe_by_user, spam_complaint and date. These addresses no longer receive SMTP e-mails. Read-only; page with limit and offset.

offset.description: Number of records to skip, for paging.

tools.name: sendpulse_list_smtp_senders
tools.description: List the sender addresses confirmed for the SMTP service. Only these can be used as from_email in sendpulse_send_smtp_email. The answer is a plain list of addresses. Read-only.

tools.name: sendpulse_send_sms
tools.description: Send an SMS to a list of phone numbers. Every message is charged to the account balance, with the price depending on the country and route, so the tool is installed switched off; when it is switched on, confirm numbers and text with the user. Returns result, campaign_id and counters. emulate true builds the campaign without sending or charging.

sender.description: Sender name, up to 11 letters and digits; some countries require a registered sender name.

phones.description: Phone numbers in international format, digits only, e.g. ["380931234567"].

date.description: When to send, as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS. Leave out to send at once.

route.description: Delivery route per country, e.g. `{"UA":"international"}`. Only where the operator requires it.

emulate.description: true tests the call: nothing is sent and nothing is charged.

tools.name: sendpulse_list_whatsapp_bots
tools.description: List the WhatsApp chatbots connected to the account: id, name, status, channel_data (the phone number and business name), inbox with the count of total and unread chats, and created_at. The id is the bot_id of the other WhatsApp tools. Read-only.

tools.name: sendpulse_list_whatsapp_chats
tools.description: List the conversations of a WhatsApp chatbot, most recent first: contact (id, name, phone in channel_data, tags, variables, last_activity_at), inbox_last_message and inbox_unread. Read-only; page with size and skip.

bot_id.description: Bot id (from the list-bots tool of the same channel), a 24-character id.

tools.name: sendpulse_list_whatsapp_messages
tools.description: Read the messages exchanged with one WhatsApp contact: id, direction (incoming or outgoing), type, data (the content), status, sent_by, is_paid and created_at. Read-only; page with size and skip.

contact_id.description: Contact id of the subscriber in that bot (contact.id in the chat list), a 24-character id.

tools.name: sendpulse_get_whatsapp_contact_by_phone
tools.description: Find the contact of a WhatsApp chatbot by phone number: id (the contact_id to write to), status, channel_data (name, phone), tags, variables, is_chat_opened and last_activity_at. Read-only.

bot_id.description: Bot id (from the list-bots tool of the same channel), a 24-character id.

phone.description: Phone number in international format, digits only, e.g. 380931234567.

tools.name: sendpulse_send_whatsapp_message
tools.description: Send a free-form text message through a WhatsApp chatbot to a contact. WhatsApp only delivers free-form messages within 24 hours after the contact last wrote; later only an approved template works, which this connector does not send. Returns the message. Delivered at once, so confirm the text with the user.

contact_id.description: Contact id of the subscriber in that bot (contact.id in the chat list), a 24-character id.

tools.name: sendpulse_list_telegram_bots
tools.description: List the Telegram chatbots connected to the account: id, name, status, channel_data (the bot username), inbox with the count of total and unread chats, and created_at. The id is the bot_id of the other Telegram tools. Read-only.

tools.name: sendpulse_list_telegram_chats
tools.description: List the conversations of a Telegram chatbot, most recent first: contact (id, name and username in channel_data, tags, variables, last_activity_at), inbox_last_message and inbox_unread. Read-only; page with size and skip.

bot_id.description: Bot id (from the list-bots tool of the same channel), a 24-character id.

tools.name: sendpulse_list_telegram_messages
tools.description: Read the messages exchanged with one Telegram contact of a chatbot: id, direction (incoming or outgoing), type, data (the content), status, sent_by and created_at. Read-only; page with size and skip.

contact_id.description: Contact id of the subscriber in that bot (contact.id in the chat list), a 24-character id.

tools.name: sendpulse_send_telegram_message
tools.description: Send a text message through a Telegram chatbot to one of its subscribers. Returns the message. The contact must have started the bot and not blocked it. Delivered at once, so confirm the text with the user.

contact_id.description: Contact id of the subscriber in that bot (contact.id in the chat list), a 24-character id.
